entities.summary: Vassilis "Billy" Toliopoulos, nicknamed "Pistoliopoulos", is a Greek professional basketball player for Panathinaikos of the Greek Basketball League (GBL) and the EuroLeague. He is a 1.88 m tall combo guard.
